value.rationale: A natural infinite non-edge-transitive Cartesian family has a complete closed-form classification of the two endpoint projection norms and their distinct maximizing edge orbits. The n=3 cut-orbit switch, n=5 cycle-orbit switch, and n=3 cut/cycle dominance transition are precise structural boundaries absent from general asymptotics. This is more than a routine special case of an available exact formula.
